name: Shojo Gentei! ~Risou no Otome no Tsukurikata~
original_name: 処女限定！～理想のオトメの作り方～
source:
Tsubasa has a dream. He wants to train a girl as he likes and keeps her as his girlfriend. He gets a teacher licence for the dream, but he can't get a job. He really wants to work at girls' high school.... As a result, he comes up with the idea. He disguises himself as a woman and has a job interview at the Virgin High School. He successfully finishes the interview and starts working there...

[From [url=https://web.archive.org/web/20090302110609/http://www.erogeshop.com:80/product_info.php/products_id/1010621]Eroge Shop[/url]]
translation:
翼有一个梦想。他想把一个女孩培养成他喜欢的样子，并让她成为他的女朋友。他为了梦想获得了教师执照，但却找不到工作。他很想在女子高中工作……于是他就产生了这个想法。他乔装成女人，去维珍高中参加工作面试。他顺利地完成了面试并开始在那里工作……

[来自[url=https://web.archive.org/web/20090302110609/http://www.erogeshop.com:80/product_info.php/products_id/1010621]工口游戏商店[/url]]
